verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows Aider natively running several task attempts in parallel or offering a way to compare them before picking one. The scripting interface (--message, Coder.run) is a developer building block a user could orchestrate externally. The community comment about reviewing and comparing results is a hypothetical user-side workaround, not a product capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
